name: radio_selector_id_wins_and_double_quote_escaped
spec_quote: It has a non-empty id → [`[id="<id>"]`, 0] (double quotes inside the id escaped with a backslash).

name: radio_selector_no_id_no_name_is_null
spec_quote: Else, with no name → null.

name: radio_selector_unique_value_uses_value_attribute
spec_quote: Else, when the value is a non-empty string and dup is not true → [`input[type=radio][name="<name>"][value="<value>"]`, 0].

name: radio_selector_duplicate_value_uses_idx
spec_quote: Else → [`input[type=radio][name="<name>"]`, idx] (idx missing = 0).

name: page_kind_app_dominates_everything
spec_quote: app → "application" (whatever else is true).

name: page_kind_register_apply_via_upload
spec_quote: else account AND (apply_btn OR attach OR upload) → "register_apply" (one page with the account fields and the application).

name: page_kind_account_beats_signin
spec_quote: else account → "register" (the account form alone).

name: page_kind_sign_in_only
spec_quote: else signin → "sign_in".

name: accept_link_data_privacy_verb_phrase

args.text: I have read and accept the data privacy statement

spec_quote: (a) a data-privacy link: a verb (read and accept / accept / open / view / review / read) followed within 30 characters by "privacy statement", "privacy agreement", "privacy policy" or "privacy notice" (optionally "data " before "privacy").

name: accept_link_terms_read_and_accept_case_insensitive

args.text: Read and accept Terms of Use

spec_quote: (b) a terms link: "read and accept", "read & accept" or "accept" followed within 30 characters by "terms of use", "terms and conditions" or "terms of service" ("Read and accept terms of use"). Case and spacing do not matter.

name: accept_link_terms_alone_is_false
spec_quote: False otherwise — in particular "Terms of use" alone, "By creating an account you agree to the Terms of use" (agree is not accept), "Danfoss Job Portal Terms", "Privacy policy" alone, "Cookie settings".

name: accept_link_agree_is_not_accept

args.text: By creating an account you agree to the Terms of use

spec_quote: False otherwise — in particular ... "By creating an account you agree to the Terms of use" (agree is not accept) ...

name: accept_link_exact_data_privacy_statement
spec_quote: or a text that is exactly "Data Privacy Statement" / "Data Privacy Agreement"; ... Case and spacing do not matter.

name: privacy_accepted_has_been_accepted

args.text: Data privacy statement has been accepted.

spec_quote: e.g. "Data privacy statement has been accepted." and "Terms of use accepted" count;

name: privacy_accepted_terms_of_use_accepted
spec_quote: e.g. "Data privacy statement has been accepted." and "Terms of use accepted" count;

name: privacy_accepted_not_been_accepted_is_false

args.text: The data privacy statement has not been accepted.

spec_quote: AND that stretch does not say it must or still has to be accepted: "not accepted", "not been accepted", "must be accepted", "should be accepted", "needs to be accepted", "has to be accepted", "to be accepted", "be accepted" all do NOT count;

name: privacy_accepted_open_and_accept_it_is_false

args.text: Please open the data privacy agreement and accept it

spec_quote: Otherwise false ("Accepted file types: PDF" is not an acceptance; neither is "Please open the data privacy agreement and accept it").

name: privacy_accepted_hidden_dpcs_value_non_empty
spec_quote: OR `dpcs_value` (the form's hidden privacy box) is a non-empty string after trimming.

name: account_ok_email_checkbox_must_stay_off
spec_quote: `fbclc_emailEnabled`, `fbclc_campaignEmailEnabled` (checkboxes that must stay off): true exactly when got equals want (want "" = off, got "" = off, "checked" = on).

name: account_ok_phone_last_ten_digits
spec_quote: `fbclc_phoneNumber`: true when the last 10 digits of got equal the last 10 digits of want (other characters ignored).

name: account_ok_email_conf_ignores_case
spec_quote: `fbclc_userName`, `fbclc_emailConf` (e-mail): equal ignoring case.

name: account_ok_other_key_with_empty_want_is_false
spec_quote: Any other key with an empty want → false.
